summary: Full testing pass on AutoLenis V4. 69/69 backend API/page tests passing. 3 critical bugs found and fixed: (1) Next.js Server Actions blocked by origin mismatch — fixed via experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins in next.config.mjs, (2) Admin auth pages stuck in infinite redirect loop — fixed by adding x-admin-auth-route header in proxy.ts and checking it in admin/layout.tsx, (3) Admin auth pages loading forever (related to bug #2). Public website, API endpoints, auth pages, and portal redirects all working.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: Server Actions were returning 500 due to x-forwarded-host vs origin mismatch in Emergent preview environment. Added experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins to next.config.mjs.

FIXED: /admin/auth/* pages were stuck in infinite redirect loop because AdminLayout called requireAdmin() which redirected back to /admin/auth/signin. Fixed by: (1) setting x-admin-auth-route header in proxy.ts for ADMIN_AUTH_ROUTES, (2) checking that header in admin/layout.tsx to skip requireAdmin().

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Server Actions origin mismatch — next.config.mjs now has experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins for Emergent preview cluster domains
FIXED: Admin auth infinite redirect — admin/layout.tsx now skips requireAdmin() for /admin/auth/* routes via x-admin-auth-route middleware header

CRON_SECRET and JWT_SECRET are empty strings in .env — cron routes will always return 401 (validateCronRequest returns false when expectedToken is empty). This may be intentional or a configuration gap.
JWT_SECRET is empty — admin JWT signing/verification may fail silently
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 21 public pages render (200). All buyer/dealer/affiliate portal pages correctly redirect to signin. Admin auth pages now render correctly after fix. Auth signin shows 'Incorrect email or password' on bad credentials. Stats strip on homepage works with live API data. /hope page has faith content. Born-again invitation only on /hope. Key fixes applied: server actions origin fix + admin auth infinite loop fix.

server_actions_500.issue: Next.js Server Actions blocked with 500 error
server_actions_500.root_cause: x-forwarded-host header (preview.emergentagent.com) didn't match origin header (cluster-11.preview.emergentcf.cloud) — Next.js security check blocks server actions from cross-origin requests
server_actions_500.fix: Added experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins in next.config.mjs with both preview domain patterns

admin_auth_infinite_loop.issue: /admin/auth/* pages stuck in infinite redirect loop — browser showing Loading... forever
admin_auth_infinite_loop.root_cause: AdminLayout (/admin/layout.tsx) calls requireAdmin() which redirects to /admin/auth/signin. Since /admin/auth/signin is nested INSIDE /admin/layout.tsx in Next.js App Router, this creates an infinite redirect loop.
admin_auth_infinite_loop.fix: Modified proxy.ts to set x-admin-auth-route: true header for ADMIN_AUTH_ROUTES, then modified AdminLayout to check this header and skip requireAdmin() for admin auth routes
